label: Claude Haiku 5.5
output:
Rick, I need you to actually hear this, so I'm putting it in writing.

You told Gary Pruitt I'd list his house for 1% as a "family rate." I never said that to you or anyone else. My listing rate is 2.5%. You quoted my commission to your buddy, cut it in half, and never asked me.

Then I spent my Saturday on it. I pulled comps, walked the house, and put together a full listing packet. That was about six hours plus the drive from north Phoenix. Gary texted Sunday night that he's going with ListLite for $3,995 flat. Fine, that's his call, and I'm not mad at him. But I did real work on a listing I was never going to get paid for, because you promised my time without asking me.

When I called you about it, you said "that's business, sis, can't win 'em all." That's not really the point. The point is you gave away my rate and my time without a word to me first.

And this morning you texted that Denise from work wants to pick my brain about her rental, and you already gave her my cell. This is the same thing that happened with your softball guy two years ago, and I let it go then. I'm not letting it go again.

So here's where things stand:

- You don't give out my number without asking me first. Every time.
- You don't quote my commission or any rate to anyone. That's my call, not yours.
- If someone wants to talk to me, they can reach out, and I'll decide whether I want the job.
- I'm not calling Denise. If you want her to know she can reach out, you can tell her yourself.

I'm glad to help real family. Mom, your kids, anybody who needs advice. I don't charge people I love for a conversation. But I'm not going to be the guy you hand out for free so you look good in front of your friends.

I'm still pissed, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise. But I'm not blowing this up either. I'm coming to Thanksgiving at your place, and I'd like it to be a normal day. I just need you to get this one thing right from now on.

Call me when you're ready to talk. Not to argue. To actually hear it.

reasons: It bans Rick from quoting commission but does not tell him to ask permission before doing so.
